en.html:
She nodded repeatedly, quite satisfied. ...My distrust increased in inverse proportion.

No-self.
Erase the self, dismiss every stray thought, acquire <ruby>direct apprehension<rt>Kan</rt></ruby> beyond the senses—then fight according to the world's will, its greater cause. That was what the monk had said.

It also connected with the Yangming teaching that an intuitive knowledge of right and wrong—“<ruby>moral knowing<rt>innate knowledge</rt></ruby>”—lay at humanity's foundation. Follow it without hesitation; do not torment oneself with distracting calculations of private profit and loss.

Indeed, a hero.
Discard oneself and fight for the world: surely that was a hero.

ja.html:
納得の様子で、繰り返し頷いている。
　……こちらは反比例して、不信の念が強まっていた。

　無我。
　自我を消して一切の雑念を去らしめ、感覚を超えた
<ruby>観<rt>カン</rt></ruby>を獲得――その上で世の意志、大義に従って戦えば
良いのだとあの僧侶は言った。

　何が正しく何が誤りかを直観的に判断する〝<ruby>良知<rt>りょうち</rt></ruby>〟
が人間の根底には備わっている、だから迷わずそれに
従えば良く、個人的な利害損得などの雑念に囚われて
悩んではならない――とする陽明学の教えにも通ずる。

　成程、英雄だ。
　我を捨て世のため戦う者、それは英雄に違いない。

en.html:
I understood it was wordplay. She was deliberately exchanging one word for another.

My fighting, my murders, had been for my own circumstances. No room for doubt, no room to transfer responsibility to society or anything else. She merely replaced circumstances with likes and dislikes, and used the substitution to shake me.

So... no need to listen.

Chachamaru"But Princess remains undefeated. Why, I wonder...?"



Chachamaru"It is settled that heroes defeat demon kings・・・・・・・・. The world wants it, so that is what must happen."



Chachamaru"Yet you cannot win."



Chachamaru"...Because you have not become the hero completely."



Kageaki"............"

en.html:
Chachamaru"You do not want to fight."
Chachamaru"Deep down, you do not want to fight Princess. Do not want to kill her."
Chachamaru"That is what lies at the bottom of your heart."
Kageaki"——————————————————————"
Chachamaru"Therefore you cannot win. Entirely natural."
Chachamaru"Thinking 'I do not want to kill her,' how will you win? Before technique, before performance, that problem comes. First you must discard that hesitation."
Kageaki"...No-self..."
Chachamaru"Exactly."
Chachamaru"Discard the self... discard personal feeling."
Chachamaru"Think of Princess only as the world's enemy. Recognize her as a demon king who must be killed."
Chachamaru"Become a hero. You must."
Chachamaru"That is your role, bhai. Is it not...?"
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Why?"
Chachamaru"...?"
Kageaki"Are you not Silver Star's ally? Why... say these things?"
Chachamaru"Love Princess, yes. But ally is a different matter."
Chachamaru"Princess cannot have allies. With allies come enemies. And Muramasa's law makes you kill both."
Chachamaru"If apun was her ally, should be dead long ago. Princess really does kill people without hostility..."
Chachamaru"You understand that already, no?"
Kageaki"..."
